name: Popol Vuh creation cycle

earliest_written_attestation.note: Library of Congress describes a lost predecessor probably prepared in the 16th century by a K’iche’ speaker using Latin characters.

surviving_manuscript_date.note: Francisco Ximénez transcription; Library of Congress describes it as one of the earliest surviving copies.

estimated_composition.method: Dates the colonial-era alphabetic composition, not the older underlying traditions.

estimated_oral_origin.method: Earlier oral and codex traditions are probable, but no defensible absolute origin date is assigned.

dating.dating_summary: Extant witness is early 18th century and derives from an earlier 16th-century K’iche’ text; older tradition is recognized without pretending to date its origin.

notes: Do not turn shared motifs with other traditions into transmission edges.
